question: Can an invited member of another account's verified build.nvidia.com organization generate an API key without a phone OTP of their own, and does the key service enforce verification for a member?
why: the site code shows the phone form only to an organization owner whose account is unverified and counts a non-owner as set up, and key generation depends on a per-organization permission; a third-party write-up claims the key-creation call does not check a phone; the backend rule is behind a sign-up (an invited member of a verified organization is needed)
